# Recall on modern LLM essays

*Generated by `python -m untell.bench.modern_recall` from [modern-llm-olmo2.json](modern-llm-olmo2.json); do not edit by hand.*

60 essays written by `allenai/OLMo-2-0425-1B-Instruct` (sampled, temperature 0.8, seeds recorded per essay) answering the same 15 PERSUADE 2.0 assignments the held-out human essays answer, prompted as a US student in grades 6–12. Each essay is scored as generated and with Markdown scaffolding (headings, bold, bullets) stripped, the way a pasted submission looks.

| detector | threshold | recall, as generated | recall, Markdown stripped | AUROC vs PERSUADE human (stripped) |
|---|---|---|---|---:|
| untell full tier (calibrated-v3) | 5% fit FPR | 55% (33/60; 95% CI 42–67%) | 55% (33/60; 95% CI 42–67%) | – |
| fakespot-ai/roberta-base-ai-text-detection-v1 | 0.5 (default) | 100% (60/60; 95% CI 94–100%) | 100% (60/60; 95% CI 94–100%) | 1.000 |
| fakespot-ai/roberta-base-ai-text-detection-v1 | 0.5381 (fitted) | 100% (60/60; 95% CI 94–100%) | 100% (60/60; 95% CI 94–100%) |  |
| openai-community/roberta-large-openai-detector | 0.5 (default) | 2% (1/60; 95% CI 0–9%) | 2% (1/60; 95% CI 0–9%) | 0.795 |
| openai-community/roberta-large-openai-detector | 0.1372 (fitted) | 7% (4/60; 95% CI 3–16%) | 7% (4/60; 95% CI 3–16%) |  |
| PirateXX/AI-Content-Detector | 0.5 (default) | 3% (2/60; 95% CI 1–11%) | 3% (2/60; 95% CI 1–11%) | 0.944 |
| PirateXX/AI-Content-Detector | 0.0188 (fitted) | 47% (28/60; 95% CI 35–59%) | 47% (28/60; 95% CI 35–59%) |  |
| desklib/ai-text-detector-v1.01 | 0.5 (default) | 100% (60/60; 95% CI 94–100%) | 100% (60/60; 95% CI 94–100%) | 1.000 |
| desklib/ai-text-detector-v1.01 | 0.8206 (fitted) | 100% (60/60; 95% CI 94–100%) | 100% (60/60; 95% CI 94–100%) |  |
| rasbt/ai-text-detector-modernbert | 0.5 (default) | 52% (31/60; 95% CI 39–64%) | 47% (28/60; 95% CI 35–59%) | 0.960 |
| rasbt/ai-text-detector-modernbert | 0.9932 (fitted) | 25% (15/60; 95% CI 16–37%) | 23% (14/60; 95% CI 14–35%) |  |

Recall is the share of these AI essays flagged. Compare with each detector's false-positive rates on human writing in the [open-detector leaderboard](open-detectors.md) and [calibration](calibration.md): a recall figure means nothing without the false-flag rate paid for it.

## Caveats

- One small open model (`allenai/OLMo-2-0425-1B-Instruct`). Frontier chat models write differently; this measures whether a detector generalises past its training text, not how it does on any particular commercial model.
- Median essay length 499 words; 46 of 60 essays hit the generation cap and end mid-sentence.
- 16 of 60 used Markdown headings, bold or bullets; the stripped column removes them.
- AUROC compares these essays with student essays on the same prompts; it can be inflated by differences in polish that have nothing to do with authorship.
